- SLA commitments: Critical CVE: Triage within 8 hours, remediation or mitigation within 72 hours; High CVE: triage within 24 hours, remediation or a documented compensating control within 14 days; Medium CVE: triage within 72 hours, remediation within 60 days. - 60-day remediation plan: For any open High/Medium items we commit to a plan with defined milestones and a named owner and weekly status updates until closure.
